_why: The rows every scenario in this folder starts from: one good read of all four fact tables, small but carrying the shapes that matter -- a [text](url) link to this repo, a literal tag quoted in backticks, a cost whose figure stands alone with no unit beside it, and a measure whose standing is empty. A scenario names only the table it breaks; the rest read these.
